correctness.rationale: Exact spherical addition formula and antipodal compression reduce the problem to 10-by-10 matrices. An explicit Q(sqrt5) vertex calculation confirms Petersen and signed-Petersen identities B^2=3I+C and B^3=5B; these supply all eigenvalues and multiplicities. Legendre recurrence performed exactly in rational pairs exhaustively determines all 561 branches for degrees 0 through 186, detects only the listed rank exceptions and isolates the unique 13th-degree positive minimum 3094/1594323 in the compressed matrix. A proved Laplace-integral bound and rational inequalities control every degree at least 187. The Gram factor two and Moore-Penrose interpolation constant are then exact.

value.rationale: A canonical dodecahedral configuration has twenty sampling points and a ten-dimensional parity-data space, distinct from the twelve-point icosahedron. Its full all-degree eigenspaces, sporadic loss of rank at degrees 5, 8 and 14, sharp eventual completeness at 15, and unique global rational stability obstruction at degree 13 provide structurally motivated spectral interpolation information. This is not an arbitrary numerical slice or merely the already-known first-moment vanishing at 8 and 14.
